messages:
joan: Heads up — CI microbench failed on PR #19677. Threshold diff +6.4% on kv-batcher throughput.

sam: ugh. which benchmark?

joan: `bench.kv_batcher_throughput` on linux-gpu-ci. failure popped in the post-merge run.

ci-bot: PR 19677 — microbench threshold exceeded (6.4%). Details: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/19677/bench-report

sam: checkpoint — was kernel-autoselect changed in that PR?

joan: yes, the PR added an additional autoselect heuristic path: `autoselect_v2` with a fallback ordering tweak.

tarek: quick theory: autoselect change can cause kernel magnetization where a slightly cheaper kernel gets chosen for many seq lengths and causes kv-cache miss amplification. saw similar pattern last year.

marta: can someone paste the perf flame snippet from the CI run?

joan: pasted from the artifact: ```
flamegraph (top few stacks):
  runtime::batcher::dispatch
  runtime::kernel::autoselect_v2::select
  kernel::matmul::alpha_fused
  kernel::matmul::fallback_hybrid
  memory::kv_cache::miss_handle
  decode::generate_loop
-- hot path shows increased time in fallback_hybrid and kv_cache miss handling
```

sam: that looks like the autoselect is steering a bunch of short sequences to the hybrid kernel which doesn't honor the fast path for KV reuse. explains throughput drop.

tarek: can we repro locally with the same seed? try running the CI microbench harness samplecfg: `./bench/run_micro --bench kv_batcher --seed 42 --kernel autoselect_v2`

joan: running now, will post numbers.

(devops-bot): Job started on runner gpu-9. ETA ~6m

joan: local run reproduces ~+5.9% throughput regression vs main. traces match CI.

marta: do we have telemetry showing KV hit rate shift?

joan: yes — KV hit dropped from 86% -> 71% on the failing trace.

sam: ok bisect plan: revert the autoselect change on the PR branch and re-run microbench in CI. if it fixes, we need a targeted fix (make autoselect cost model aware of kv-cache benefit).

tarek: another quick mitigation: add a temporary rule that prefers `matmul_fast` for seq_len <= 64 or when kv_cache_hitrate EXPECTED > 80% — cheap to toggle.

joan: created issue: INF-2389 "autoselect_v2 magnetization -> kv miss spike" and attached perf artifacts.

joan: immediate action: request revert on PR and request a new CI run. @devops-bot can you cancel the rollout gate?

devops-bot: Revert requested. CI rerun queued: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/19677/retry

marta: also add an evaluation test: measure kv hit rate delta in the perf unit; fail if hit drops >5%. prevents silent regressions.

sam: agreed. I'll own the bisect and the short-term config patch. tarek can own a longer term cost-model tweak.

joan: thanks. will post updates when CI finishes. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: rerun finished — microbench now within delta (0.3%) after manual revert.

sam: revert confirmed. marking PR as rollback-blocker until INF-2389 has an accepted fix.

marta: assigning INF-2389 to sam + tarek, priority P1 for next sprint.

joan: closing loop for now. follow-ups: (1) short-term selector config (sam) (2) cost-model + kv-awareness (tarek) (3) perf unit test with kv-hitrate assertion (marta).

sam: noted. will open PR for config patch today.
